2026-04-25 manual registry correction: align D5/D6/S1 room ownership with RC checklist, location_registry.json, and dungeon map docs; remove stale D2 claims for D5 Glacia rooms; keeps S3/D4 disputed rooms unchanged pending a separate runtime audit

2026-09-26 room-census correction: D1/D2/D3/D4/D7/FOS/SOC room lists follow ROM connectivity (mutual doors + stair objects) and the ZScream entrance table in bank $0F (yaze dungeon-get-entrance reads the old $02:C813 table). Moved: 0x5B FOS->D1, 0xA5 FOS->D7, 0x54/0x66 D4->D3, 0x76 D4->SOP, 0x04/0x13/0x14/0x15/0x23/0x24 D7->none (Master Sword Cave / Final Boss Route, entrances 0x18/0x19/0x2D/0x24). Removed empty rooms 0x1F (D2) and 0x95/0x96/0xA6 (FOS). Added D2 0x6F/0x8F, D3 prison+basement, D4 0x44/0x45/0x10B, D7 lower hold, FOS 0x2D, SOC 0x07/0x17/0x32. Entrances corrected: D2 0x15->0x5F, SOP 0x03/0x05/0x09/0x0B, D3 0x28->0x56 and 0x32->0x55, SOC 0x0C->0x53 (0x0C is not a FOS entrance; FOS is 0x37->0x0C). Stairs/holewarps/doors of the changed dungeons regenerated with extract_room_connectivity.py functions; holewarps are header values only (rooms in RoomsWithPitDamage $00:990C never use them). The pause-map room grids (bank $0A) still list 0x5B/0x95/0x96/0xA5/0xA6 under FOS and 0x33/0x43/0x53/0x63 under S2.
